study_design: Prospective nested case-control study within the Prostate Cancer Prevention Trial using baseline serum samples and biopsy-assessed prostate cancer.
reason: The abstract analyzes prostate cancer risk without reporting an aggressive, high-grade, high-risk, advanced, metastatic, or lethal endpoint. The total analytic sample is not stated directly and was not inferred by summing cases and controls.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: In the placebo arm, above median serum 25(OH)D levels were associated with increased risk of prostate cancer among men with higher IGF-2 (OR:1.33, 95% CI: 1.00-1.65), with a significant interaction between 25(OH)D and treatment arm (P<sub>interaction</sub> = 0.04).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate concerns prostate cancer risk generally among placebo-arm men with higher IGF-2; no aggressive disease qualifier is given.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
